parsed.change_summary: Added a sanitize_input function to remove non-alphanumeric characters from line.param_one before passing it to the insert function.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the sanitize_input function removes any non-alphanumeric characters from line.param_one before passing it to the insert function. This prevents any malicious input from being executed as a command.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior of the program has changed. The insert function now receives a sanitized version of line.param_one, which has all non-alphanumeric characters removed. This may affect the functionality of the program if the original input contained necessary non-alphanumeric characters.
